SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT NVL(WERKS,' ') AS PLANT, NVL(EBELN,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO FROM SAPDEP.ZKEP_PO WHERE 1=1 AND IF_FLAG in ('1','9') GROUP BY NVL(WERKS,' '), NVL(EBELN,' ')
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'STDW' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, NVL(MANDT,' ') AS MANDT, NVL(WERKS,' ') AS REF_IF_NO, NVL(EBELN,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, NVL(EBELP,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, NVL(STATUS,' ') AS STATUS, NVL(LTRIM(TO_CHAR(MATNR),'0'),' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(NETPR, 0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(MENGE, 0) AS ITEM_QTY, NVL(NETWR, 0) AS ITEM_AMT, NVL(AEDAT,' ') AS ADD_DATE, NVL(EINDT,' ') AS RD_DATE, NVL(LGORT,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, NVL(LGOBE,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT, NVL(ERNAM,' ') AS PURCHASER_USER_ID, NVL(REMARK,' ') AS REMARK, NVL(TXZ01,' ') AS DESCRIPTION, NVL(ZSTAN,' ') AS SPECIFICATION, NVL(MEINS,' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE, NVL(ZEINR,' ') AS ZEINR, NVL(QAACT,' ') AS QAACT, NVL(QATYP,' ') AS QATYP, NVL(ZBOXC,' ') AS ZBOXC, NVL(BSTRF, 0) AS BSTRF, NVL(ZJISI,' ') AS ZJISI, NVL(POSID,' ') AS POSID, NVL(ZBSUC,' ') AS ZBSUC, NVL(KOSTL,' ') AS KOSTL, NVL(J_1KFREPRE,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, NVL(WAERS,' ') AS WAERS, NVL(EKGRP,' ') AS EKGRP, NVL(ZEINR,' ') ||'^'|| NVL(QAACT,' ') ||'^'|| NVL(QATYP,' ') ||'^'|| NVL(ZBOXC,' ') ||'^'|| NVL(BSTRF, 0) ||'^'|| NVL(ZJISI,' ') ||'^'|| NVL(POSID,' ') ||'^'|| NVL(ZBSUC,' ') ||'^'|| NVL(KOSTL,' ') ||'^'|| NVL(J_1KFREPRE,' ') ||'^'|| NVL(WAERS,' ') ||'^'|| NVL(EKGRP,' ') ||'^' AS IV_COLUMN, NVL(BANFN,' ') AS PR_NO, NVL(BNFPO,' ') AS PR_SEQ , NVL(BANFN,' ')||'-'||NVL(BNFPO,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO FROM SAPDEP.ZKEP_PO WHERE IF_FLAG in ('1','9') AND NVL(WERKS,' ') = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND NVL(EBELN,' ') = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' ORDER BY MANDT,WERKS,EBELN,EBELP
UPDATE SAPDEP.ZKEP_PO SET IF_FLAG = '2', IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE 1=1 AND IF_FLAG in ('1','9') AND NVL(WERKS,' ') = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND NVL(EBELN,' ') = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$'
